meta.title: About LipoNexus
meta.description: Learn about LipoNexus's mission to develop a non-invasive blood test for early detection of Fatty Liver Disease using inflammatory lipid biomarkers.

hero.headline: Reimagining How Fatty Liver Disease Is Detected
hero.body: Founded in San Diego, California, LipoNexus was born from a simple but powerful insight: the inflammatory lipid landscape of the blood changes meaningfully as fatty liver disease progresses — and those changes can be measured accurately, non-invasively, and affordably.

mission.headline: Our Mission
mission.body: To develop a highly accurate, non-invasive blood test for the early detection and assessment of Fatty Liver Disease through inflammatory lipid biomarkers — enabling earlier intervention, better outcomes, and a healthier world.

approach.headline: Our Scientific Approach
approach.body: Fatty liver disease is characterized by the dysregulation of lipid metabolism and the activation of hepatic inflammatory pathways. LipoNexus has identified a panel of inflammatory lipid biomarkers — including specific oxylipins, lysophospholipids, and ceramide species — that are robustly associated with disease presence, severity, and progression.

points.title: Biomarker Discovery
points.description: Untargeted lipidomics in well-characterized patient cohorts to identify candidate biomarkers with strong disease association.

points.title: Assay Development
points.description: Translation of discovery findings into a targeted, quantitative, clinical-grade blood assay.

points.title: Clinical Validation
points.description: Rigorous validation against histological ground truth (liver biopsy) across diverse patient populations.

points.title: Regulatory Pathway
points.description: Strategic planning toward FDA clearance and CMS reimbursement for widespread clinical adoption.

items.title: Scientific Rigor
items.description: We hold our work to the highest standards of evidence — every claim is backed by data.

items.title: Patient Impact
items.description: Everything we build is ultimately in service of patients who deserve earlier answers and better care.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: We communicate openly with partners, investors, and collaborators about our progress and challenges.

items.title: Collaboration
items.description: We believe the best science emerges from strong partnerships across academia, industry, and clinical medicine.
